settings.subtitle: The growing chair for primary schoolers: backrest and seat adjust together in four stages as your child grows, with a dedicated footrest for steady posture.

settings.heading: SIDIZ RINGO Growing Chair for Primary Schoolers
settings.body:
• Hidden-button growing adjustment - children adjust the backrest height and seat depth themselves, across four stages.
  • A dedicated footrest for the lower body - supports the legs steadily and guides upright posture.
  • Rounded form design - a softly curved frame throughout removes the hazards of hard corners.

An ergonomic growing solution: a mechanism matched to each stage of childhood builds straight posture and settled focus for learning.

settings.subtitle: Dream to grow
settings.heading: RINGO
settings.alt: A child growing with the SIDIZ RINGO chair
settings.description:
A child's growth is more than physical change - it is a journey toward limitless possibility. The SIDIZ RINGO supports both the changing body and the expanding mind, staying alongside every moment of finding their own path.

A growing mechanism optimises the backrest and seat together at each stage of childhood, bringing straight posture, settled comfort and the best environment for learning to take hold.

settings.subheading:
From the first day of primary school to the last,
posture held true as they grow
settings.description: Designed from close observation of how children grow, the RINGO keeps a child comfortably immersed through every moment the body and mind expand.
settings.alt: The RINGO adjusting through the primary years

settings.title: 2WAY growing: backrest and seat together
settings.description: Backrest height and seat depth extend together along a 25 degree diagonal, supporting a growing child naturally - SIDIZ's own 2way growing. *Korean Patent No. 10-2014-0094938.

settings.title: Four growing stages, junior years to senior
settings.description: Adjusts with each stage of growth for a closer, more comfortable fit. Stage 1: 110-125 cm. Stage 2: 125-135 cm. Stage 3: 135-150 cm. Stage 4: 150-160 cm.

settings.title: A one-touch hidden growing button children use safely
settings.description: Tucked inside the handle, the growing button lets a child find the fit that suits them - and keeps the diagonal growing motion at its most natural.

settings.subheading:
Straight posture from precise support -
the solid basics behind every achievement
settings.description: Every kind of growth starts from the basics, and straight posture is the steady starting point for creativity and imagination. Backrest and footrest support with height adjustment lay the foundation - the possibilities go on from there.
settings.alt: A child sitting upright in the RINGO

settings.title: Precise height adjustment for each growth stage
settings.description: Comfortable posture depends on where the elbows and shoulders sit; the button sets the right height against the desk.

settings.title: A dedicated footrest for steady legs and a settled mind
settings.description: When the chair is raised to the desk and small feet cannot reach the floor, the footrest carries the legs so posture stays stable and upright.
settings.alt: A child's feet resting on the RINGO footrest

settings.title: A rounded backrest that hugs without fidgeting
settings.description: Firm and generously padded, the backrest supports the lower back naturally so long stretches of focus stay comfortable.

settings.title: Materials certified safe for children
settings.description: The RINGO is certified under Korea's Children's Product Safety Special Act (KC), which tests for hazardous substances and safe form.

settings.title: A rounded frame with nothing protruding
settings.description: Protruding levers are removed and every corner rounded, so an active child uses the chair safely.

settings.title: A fixed column that curbs restlessness
settings.description: The column does not swivel, helping a child settle into focus naturally.

settings.title: Durable synthetic leather that wipes clean
settings.description: Spills and food marks wipe away easily, keeping everyday mess hygienic to manage.

settings.title: Sit-brake castors, sold separately
settings.description: Castors that resist rolling under a seated child's weight can be purchased separately and swapped in to match study habits.

settings.title: A removable fabric cover, always like new
settings.description: A washable cover protects the chair from stains and clips on and off easily.

settings.heading: The details behind a children's chair
Easy Repair: like new, for years
settings.description: The RINGO is designed so that only the parts that naturally wear are replaced - economical long use, with the chair feeling new again each time.

settings.title: An easy-care seat that swaps without tools
settings.description: The seat fastens with a snap fit, so it detaches and replaces the moment it stains - no tools needed.

settings.title: A backrest that swaps with a single bolt
settings.description: One bolt releases and refits the backrest, keeping it in like-new condition.

settings.title: A footrest that detaches as they grow
settings.description: When your child outgrows the footrest, remove the bolts and take it off. *Chairs ship with either of two fastening designs; assembly differs slightly but performance and quality are identical.

settings.title: Castors that swap with the supplied spanner
settings.description: Castors bought separately come with a dedicated spanner for easy removal and refitting.

settings.title: Reinforced back and seat layers that hold posture
settings.description: Where generation 1 was slim and sleek, generation 2 adds 25 mm to the backrest and 20 mm to the seat for a gentler, steadier sit.

settings.title: Premium tone-on-tone colours for the room
settings.description: From generation 1's bright, imagination-sparking colours to generation 2's neutral palette that completes a considered kids' room.

settings.title: Generation 1: the intuitive lever
settings.description: An easy-to-grip, protruding lever made adjustment obvious.

settings.title: Generation 2: the hidden growing button
settings.description: Recessing the control removes the protrusion - preventing knocks and completing a clean, simple exterior.

settings.title: Easy self-care, tools not required
settings.description: The seat snaps off and the backrest releases with one bolt, so worn parts swap easily and the chair keeps its first-day condition.

settings.heading: Adjustment to upkeep: the leap past generation 1
RINGO | EASY REPAIR
settings.subtitle: Repair it, keep it longer
settings.description: Even after long use, buy just the part you need and swap it in to keep the chair like new.

settings.heading: RINGO | 5-year warranty
settings.body: So the journey with your RINGO continues, SIDIZ provides a 5-year warranty to customers who complete product registration. Once your chair arrives, register it before you forget, for more comfortable years ahead.

settings.title: Check the footrest direction before assembly
settings.body: Assemble with the front of the chair body facing the footrest. Rotating the body after the fixed column is assembled can cause damage.

settings.title: Washing the fabric cover
settings.body: Wash gently at 40 degrees. No oxygen bleach. Iron between 80 and 120 degrees if needed. No dry cleaning. Dry flat, in the shade.

settings.title: Removing stains from the frame
settings.body: If the frame gets marked, a melamine sponge lifts stains easily. *Rubbing hard can damage the surface.

settings.question: Up to what age can the RINGO gen2 be used?
settings.answer: The recommended height range is 110 to 160 cm - designed around standard child growth data to suit roughly ages 6 to 13, though every child grows at their own pace.

settings.question: At what height is the footrest recommended?
settings.answer: From 110 to 140 cm. Standing on the footrest can roll or tip the chair - please supervise so it is used safely.

settings.question: Is there a castor that both rolls and holds?
settings.answer: Yes - sit-brake castors resist rolling once a sitter over 25 kg is seated, and are sold separately on sidiz.au.

settings.question: Any tips for keeping it like new?
settings.answer: The synthetic leather wipes clean easily; with persistent staining, the backrest and seat can be replaced. A washable fabric cover is also sold separately.

settings.question: The column rotates - is that a fault?
settings.answer: First, sit in the chair and load it fully so the column and body seat together; after assembly, avoid forcing the chair to rotate. A chair forced around once will turn more easily afterwards.
